payload.title: 15 Best Bali Wedding Venues From Clifftops to Beaches
payload.excerpt: Bali wedding venues fall into four areas: the clifftops of the Bukit and Uluwatu, the beaches of Nusa Dua and Jimbaran, the west coast at Seminyak, and the river valleys around Ubud.
key_takeaways: Choose the area first and the venue second, because a clifftop chapel, a Nusa Dua ballroom and an Ubud river lawn suit very different guest lists.

Published capacities range from a 16-guest hidden room in Seminyak to garden and ballroom spaces for well over a thousand in Nusa Dua and at AYANA, so match the space to your numbers before you fall for the view.
Only Samabe and COMO Uma Ubud publish a full resort buy-out, so ask every other venue in writing whether the property can be closed to other guests.
Bali's wet season usually runs from around October to April, and Smartraveller advises a high degree of caution in Indonesia, so build weather and travel fallbacks into your plans.

faq.q: Can I legally marry in Bali?
faq.a: Yes, if you meet Indonesia's requirements. Both parties must hold the same recognised religion, Australians need a Certificate of No Impediment, and non-Muslim marriages must be registered with the Civil Registry Office to be legal. Check the details with the Australian Embassy and Indonesian authorities before you book.

faq.q: Which Bali venues have a wedding chapel?
faq.a: AYANA has Tresna Chapel above the Indian Ocean, The Mulia a floating glass chapel, The St. Regis the beachfront Cloud Nine Chapel, The Apurva Kempinski the glass Kimaya Chapel, and Bvlgari lists a chapel wedding.

faq.q: Which Bali venues can host 100 guests?
faq.a: Four Seasons Jimbaran Bay's Gili Jimbaran, The Mulia's Oceanfront Glass House and a COMO Uma Ubud buy-out each take up to 100. For more, Grand Hyatt, The St. Regis, W Bali Seminyak and AYANA publish larger spaces.

faq.q: Can we book a private villa or the whole resort for a Bali wedding?
faq.a: Some venues publish it. Samabe offers a buy-out of the entire resort, and COMO Uma Ubud a resort buy-out for up to 100. For a villa wedding, The Edge, Mandapa and Four Seasons Jimbaran Bay's Imperial Villa all host the ceremony at a villa.

faq.q: How far is Ubud from Bali's airport?
faq.a: COMO Uma Ubud is 90 minutes by car from Ngurah Rai International Airport. Ask each venue for the journey time on your guests' arrival day.
